pd_sign_in_intro: Your list and your place in every title, on any device.
pd_about_description: Where Parda's catalogue comes from, how playback works, why players may show ads and how to block them, and how titles are taken down.
pd_about_intro: Parda is a non-commercial catalogue of movies, series and anime. It shows no ads of its own and takes no payments.
pd_about_catalogue_body: Titles, pictures, cast and crew come from Parda's own catalogue. Where a description has no Nepali version, Parda shows the English one.
pd_about_justwatch: Where a page says where to watch a title, that information comes from JustWatch.
pd_about_playback_body: No video plays on Parda yet. Its servers are placeholders until a licensed provider is connected.
pd_about_players_body: When one is, its player runs in a frame of its own, from its own site. A player can show its own ads and use its own trackers, and Parda can't see or change what happens inside it.
pd_about_blocker_body: uBlock Origin Lite is a free browser extension that blocks ads and trackers, inside players too. Install it from your browser's official store:
pd_about_blocker_phones: Most phone browsers, such as Chrome on Android, don't take extensions. There, the Brave browser blocks ads on its own, and AdGuard DNS blocks them for the whole device.
pd_about_blocker_caveat: No blocker catches everything: a player may still show ads, or refuse to play while one is on.
pd_about_takedowns_body: A title can be taken down at a rights holder's request. It then leaves every list, page and search on Parda.

ch_about_intro: Chaal (चाल, “a move”) is a chess app built on Lichess, with a board drawn like the diagrams in a chess book.
ch_about_lichess_body: Games, players, puzzles and online play come from Lichess, the free and open chess server, through its public API. Every game and player here links back to lichess.org.
ch_about_not_affiliated: Chaal is not affiliated with Lichess or endorsed by it.
ch_about_fair_play: Lichess's rules are Chaal's: while you play a game on Lichess, the engine, cloud evaluation and opening explorer stay off.
ch_about_account_body: Everything public works without an account. To play online or record your puzzles, you connect your Lichess account: you sign in on Lichess and approve what Chaal may do. Chaal never sees your password.
ch_about_account_token: Lichess gives Chaal a token, which stays encrypted on our server and never reaches your browser. Disconnect in settings any time: Chaal revokes the token at Lichess and forgets it.
ch_about_credit_pieces_by: The cburnett set, by Colin M. L. Burnett, unmodified
ch_about_credit_text_type_by: Inter, by Rasmus Andersson; Noto Sans Devanagari, by Google
ch_about_stockfish_body: Analysis and games against the computer use Stockfish, free software under the GNU General Public License, version 3. It runs unmodified in your browser, loaded only when a page needs it.
